prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding fallback flows during adoption (new_flow) was helpful (+8.0%), though the predicted +10.0% was slightly too high.
Interactive wait screen tips and status updates (wait_info) were helpful (+5.1%), but the predicted +12.0% significantly overestimated the impact.
Account sync reassurance warnings and hints at sign-in showed no clear effect (+0.2%).
Copy updates at the finish step showed no clear effect, despite leaning positive (+5.9%, p=0.119).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +8.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +5.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.2% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Personality Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a split layout to showcase pet personality animations and sound previews alongside choices. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (62.7% conversion, 89s median), showing users struggle or hesitate during pet selection.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Path Preview Screen: Add a dedicated interactive preview screen (new_path_preview) before choose_path to let users sample adoption routes. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with high mean duration (514s), indicating users are uncertain which path to select.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress Bar with Mascot: Add a progress bar component and mascot animation to the waiting screen to reduce perceived wait time. (why: Home waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing hesitation before home_intro.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Launcher Verification Screen: Insert a new screen (new_desktop_verify) right before home_intro that confirms pet rendering on screen. (why: 3 support tickets complained that the pet does not appear on the desktop or the app will not open after setup.)
4: [finish, incentive] Finish Screen Desktop Shortcut Reminder: Add a highlight button and preview banner on home_intro encouraging users to pin the pet to the system tray. (why: 4 support tickets noted desktop features misbehaving after setup and 35.2% drop off at finish.)

scores.note: Adoption step loses 37.3% of users; major layout redesign requires significant release effort.
Choose_path has high completion time, but inserting a new screen introduces extra friction.
Wait_info changes previously yielded +5.1% lift; directly targets high wait duration.
Strong support evidence, but creating an entirely new verification screen adds step friction.
High drop-off (35.2%) backed by 4 support tickets; low-cost banner on existing screen.
